screen: This is done on a dedicated screen built for the job, not as a list.
studio: This is set up visually in a studio with a live preview, not as a list.
edit: You can add, edit and remove items here.
settings: Turn options on or off. Changes apply to every device right away.
read: Calculated from sales, stock and shifts. Filter and export; numbers can’t be edited.
record: Created by cashiers at the register. You can view and export; refunds and voids start at the POS or come to you as approvals.
incoming: Arrives from GoFood, GrabFood, ShopeeFood, your web store and guests. You can accept, update status or reply, but you can’t create them here.
approve: Requests from cashiers, PICs and managers. Approve or reject; nothing is created here. Stock counts are done on the PIC tablet, blind, with photo proof; a submitted count is locked and can only be recounted, not edited.
